```{r}
# LEGEND NUMBERS helper: prints to console and appends to one text file.
LEGEND_FILE <- "Figure3_legend_numbers.txt"
cat("Figure 3 - legend numbers\nGenerated: ", format(Sys.time()), "\n",
    file = LEGEND_FILE, sep = "")
legend_out <- function(title, x = NULL) {
  body <- if (is.null(x)) character(0) else if (is.character(x)) x
          else utils::capture.output(print(as.data.frame(x), row.names = FALSE))
  txt <- c("", paste0("=== ", title, " ==="), body)
  cat(txt, sep = "\n"); cat(txt, sep = "\n", file = LEGEND_FILE, append = TRUE)
  invisible(NULL)
}
n_si <- function(df, ..., id = "MM_ID") {
  df %>% dplyr::group_by(...) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(n_samples = dplyr::n(),
                     n_infants = dplyr::n_distinct(.data[[id]]), .groups = "drop")
}
```

```{r}
#PRE-NEC

# Load the data
metadata <- read.delim("metadata_cleaned_april.txt")
taxa_cleaned <- read.delim("taxa_cleaned_jan.txt")
row.names(taxa_cleaned)<-taxa_cleaned$ID
taxa_cleaned$ID=NULL
row.names(metadata)<-metadata$ID
metadata_infant <- metadata[grep("^B", rownames(metadata)), ]
taxa_infant <- taxa_cleaned[grep("^B", rownames(taxa_cleaned)), ]
# Factors (categorical/binary variables)
factor_vars <- c("prolonged_rupt", "surgery", "ab48", "multiple", "delivery_md",
                 "maternal_atb", "mother_st_com", "placenta_ab", "pe_hellp",
                 "maternal_infect", "mother_b_hem", "nec",
                 "sex", "sip", "sepsis_culture", "pda_sign", "mortality",
                 "pda", "probiotics", "SGA", "LGA", "FGR", "ivh", "abtx")
# Numeric (continuous variables)
numeric_vars <- c("mmpercentage", "probiotic_sample","apgar_1", "apgar_5", "antibiotic_sample", "ga_exact", "bw", "admissiontime", "tpn_days", "TFEF_B", "TFEF", "DNA_conc","Clean_reads_P1", "week", "Postnatal_Age", "MM_ID" )
# Apply to dataframe
metadata_infant[factor_vars] <- lapply(metadata_infant[factor_vars], as.factor)
metadata_infant[numeric_vars] <- lapply(metadata_infant[numeric_vars], as.numeric)
# Verify
str(metadata_infant[, c(factor_vars, numeric_vars)])

# --- Restrict to pre-NEC samples ----------------------------------------
# Ensure nec_timing is numeric before comparison
metadata_infant$nec_timing <- metadata_infant$necpostnatal - metadata_infant$Postnatal_Age
metadata_infant$nec_timing <- as.numeric(as.character(metadata_infant$nec_timing))

# Classify each sample relative to NEC onset
# (case_when is order-sensitive: nec_timing == 0 falls into "pre_NEC")
metadata_infant$nec_stage <- case_when(
  metadata_infant$nec_timing >= 0   ~ "pre_NEC",
  metadata_infant$nec_timing <= 0   ~ "post_NEC",
  is.na(metadata_infant$nec_timing) ~ "no_NEC"
)

legend_out("All infant samples by NEC stage (before removing post-NEC samples)",
           metadata_infant %>% n_si(nec_stage))
legend_out("Check: nec = 1 without an onset day (would be counted as no_NEC)",
           as.character(sum(metadata_infant$nec == "1" &
                              is.na(metadata_infant$necpostnatal))))
legend_out("Samples taken on the day of NEC onset (counted as pre-NEC)",
           as.character(sum(metadata_infant$nec_timing == 0, na.rm = TRUE)))

# Drop post-NEC samples; keep pre-onset + never-NEC controls
metadata_infant <- metadata_infant[metadata_infant$nec_stage %in% c("pre_NEC", "no_NEC"), ]

cat("Samples after NEC-stage filter:\n"); print(table(metadata_infant$nec_stage))
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------

taxa=taxa_infant[row.names(taxa_infant)%in% rownames(metadata_infant),] # Only taxa present in infants 
setdiff (rownames(taxa), rownames(metadata_infant)) # all good 
taxa_sp=taxa
taxa_sp=taxa_sp[,grep("s__",colnames(taxa_sp))]
taxa_sp=taxa_sp[,-grep("t__",colnames(taxa_sp))]
taxa_sub_species<-taxa[,grep("t__",colnames(taxa))]
taxa_genus=taxa
taxa_genus=taxa_genus[,grep("g__",colnames(taxa_genus))]
taxa_genus=taxa_genus[,-grep("s__",colnames(taxa_genus))]
#Simplify names
colnames(taxa_sp)=gsub(".*s__","",colnames(taxa_sp))
colnames(taxa_sub_species)=gsub(".*t__","",colnames(taxa_sub_species))
colnames(taxa_genus)=gsub(".*g__","",colnames(taxa_genus))
taxa_sp$Bifidobacterium_longum=NULL
taxa_sp$Bifidobacterium_animalis=NULL
taxa_sp$Streptococcus_thermophilus=NULL
taxa_sp <- taxa_sp %>% mutate(across(everything(), ~ as.numeric(.)))
taxa_sub_species <- taxa_sub_species %>% mutate(across(everything(), ~ as.numeric(.)))
richness <- plyr::ddply(taxa_sp,~rownames(taxa_sp),function(x) {
  data.frame(RICHNESS=sum(x[-1]>0, na.rm = T))})
row.names(richness)<-richness$`rownames(taxa_sp)`
richness$`rownames(taxa_sp)`=NULL
my_alpha_diversity=data.frame(Shannon=diversity(taxa_sp, index = "shannon"), Simpson=diversity(taxa_sp, index = "simpson"))
my_alpha_diversity=merge(my_alpha_diversity, richness, by="row.names")
row.names(my_alpha_diversity)=my_alpha_diversity$Row.names
my_alpha_diversity$Row.names=NULL
phenos_imputed_div=merge(my_alpha_diversity, metadata_infant, by="row.names")
row.names(phenos_imputed_div)=phenos_imputed_div$Row.names
phenos_imputed_div$Row.names=NULL
taxa_sp$ID<-row.names(taxa_sp)
taxa_sp$personal_ID<-sub ("_.*",  "",  taxa_sp$ID)
unique_counts <- sapply(taxa_sp, function(x) length(unique(taxa_sp$personal_ID[x >0.05]))) 
taxa_sp_filt <- taxa_sp[, unique_counts >= 1]  
taxa_sp_filt$personal_ID=NULL
taxa_sp_filt$ID=NULL
#CLR Transformations
my_pseudocount_normal=min(taxa_sp_filt[taxa_sp_filt!=0])/2
# Align the taxa table to the phenotype table by row name.
stopifnot(setequal(row.names(taxa_sp_filt), row.names(phenos_imputed_div)))
taxa_sp_filt <- taxa_sp_filt[row.names(phenos_imputed_div), , drop = FALSE]
my_distance_CLR=vegdist(taxa_sp_filt, method = "aitchison", pseudocount=my_pseudocount_normal) 
taxa_sp_filt_CLR <- decostand(taxa_sp_filt, "clr", pseudocount=my_pseudocount_normal)
mypcoa_CLR=cmdscale(my_distance_CLR, k = 20, eig = T)
my_var_CLR=round(mypcoa_CLR$eig*100/sum(mypcoa_CLR$eig),2)[1:20]
barplot (my_var_CLR)
mypcoa_df_CLR=as.data.frame(mypcoa_CLR$points)
names(mypcoa_df_CLR) <- c('PC1','PC2','PC3','PC4','PC5', 'PC6','PC7','PC8','PC9','PC10',
                          'PC11','PC12','PC13','PC14','PC15', 'PC16','PC17','PC18','PC19','PC20')
phenos_imputed_div_pc_CLR=merge(mypcoa_df_CLR,phenos_imputed_div, by="row.names")
row.names (phenos_imputed_div_pc_CLR)<-phenos_imputed_div_pc_CLR$Row.names

legend_out("Analysed samples (post-NEC removed) by NEC status",
           phenos_imputed_div %>% n_si(nec))
legend_out("Pre-NEC samples: days before onset",
           {x <- phenos_imputed_div$nec_timing[phenos_imputed_div$nec_stage == "pre_NEC"]
            sprintf("median %g, range %g-%g days", median(x), min(x), max(x))})
```


```{r}
col_no  <- "#009E73"   # bluish green — No NEC
col_yes <- "#CC79A7"   # purple       — NEC

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Figure 3A — Shannon diversity by NEC status across postnatal weeks
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

phenos_imputed_div$nec <- factor(as.character(phenos_imputed_div$nec),
                                 levels = c("0", "1"),
                                 labels = c("No", "Yes"))

phenos_imputed_div$week <- factor(as.character(phenos_imputed_div$week),
                                  levels = c("1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6", "7", "8"),
                                  labels = c("W1", "W2", "W3", "W4", "W5", "W6", "W7", "W8"))

# ── Statistical tests per week ────────────────────────────────────────────────
stats_3A <- phenos_imputed_div %>%
  filter(!is.na(Shannon), !is.na(nec), !is.na(week)) %>%
  group_by(week) %>%
  filter(n_distinct(nec) == 2) %>%
  mutate(nec = droplevels(nec)) %>%
  summarise(
    p_value = wilcox.test(Shannon ~ nec, exact = FALSE)$p.value,
    y_pos   = max(Shannon, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.05,   # just above the max value
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    p_adj        = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH"),
    significance = case_when(
      p_adj < 0.001 ~ "***",
      p_adj < 0.01  ~ "**",
      p_adj < 0.05  ~ "*",
      TRUE          ~ " "
    )
  )

# ── Plot ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

plot_data_3A <- phenos_imputed_div %>%
  filter(!is.na(Shannon) & !is.na(nec) & !is.na(week))

shannon_plot <- ggplot(plot_data_3A,
                       aes(x = week, y = Shannon, fill = nec, color = nec)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values  = c("No" = col_no, "Yes" = col_yes)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("No" = col_no, "Yes" = col_yes)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.4, outlier.colour = NA) +
  geom_point(
    alpha    = 0.6,
    position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.3, jitter.height = 0)
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data        = stats_3A,
    aes(x = week, y = y_pos, label = significance),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    size        = 5
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(
    x     = "Postnatal Week",
    y     = "Shannon Diversity Index",
    fill  = "NEC",
    color = "NEC"
  ) +
  theme(
    axis.title.y = element_text(color = "black", size = 18),
    axis.title.x = element_text(color = "black", size = 18),
    axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.text.x  = element_text(size = 12, angle = 60, hjust = 1)
  )

print(shannon_plot)
ggsave("4A_shannon_with_nec_week.pdf", plot = shannon_plot,
       width = 6, height = 5)
cat("✓ Saved: 4A_shannon_with_nec_week.pdf\n")

# ── Sample counts ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

sample_counts_3A <- phenos_imputed_div %>%
  filter(!is.na(Shannon), !is.na(nec), !is.na(week)) %>%
  group_by(week, nec) %>%
  summarise(N_samples = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from  = nec,
              values_from = N_samples,
              values_fill = 0) %>%
  rename(NEC_No = No, NEC_Yes = Yes)

print(sample_counts_3A)

# LEGEND NUMBERS: Fig. 3a (Shannon computed after removing probiotic species)
legend_out("Fig 3a - samples / infants per week and NEC status",
           plot_data_3A %>% n_si(week, nec))
legend_out("Fig 3a - per-week Wilcoxon (two-sided), BH across weeks",
           stats_3A %>% transmute(week, p_value = signif(p_value, 3),
                                  p_adj = signif(p_adj, 3)))
# Overall test across weeks
dat3a <- plot_data_3A %>%
  filter(!is.na(Postnatal_Age), !is.na(Clean_reads_P1), !is.na(DNA_conc)) %>%
  mutate(across(c(Postnatal_Age, Clean_reads_P1, DNA_conc),
                ~ as.numeric(scale(.x)), .names = "{.col}_z"))
m0_3a <- lmer(Shannon ~ Postnatal_Age_z + Clean_reads_P1_z + DNA_conc_z + (1 | MM_ID),
              data = dat3a, REML = FALSE)
m1_3a <- update(m0_3a, . ~ . + nec)
cf_3a <- summary(m1_3a)$coefficients
legend_out("Fig 3a - overall LMM: Shannon ~ NEC + age + reads + DNA conc + (1|infant)",
           sprintf("n = %d samples / %d infants | effect = %.3f (SE %.3f) | LRT p = %.2g",
                   nrow(dat3a), dplyr::n_distinct(dat3a$MM_ID),
                   cf_3a["necYes", "Estimate"], cf_3a["necYes", "Std. Error"],
                   anova(m1_3a, m0_3a)[["Pr(>Chisq)"]][2]))

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Figure 3B — PCoA coloured by NEC status
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

phenos_imputed_div_pc_CLR$nec <- factor(as.character(phenos_imputed_div_pc_CLR$nec),
                                 levels = c("0", "1"),
                                 labels = c("No", "Yes"))

pcoa_plot <- ggplot(phenos_imputed_div_pc_CLR, aes(PC1, PC2, color = nec)) +

               type = "norm", linetype = 2, geom = "path",

  xlab(paste0("PCo1 = ", round(my_var_CLR[1], 2), "%")) +
  ylab(paste0("PCo2 = ", round(my_var_CLR[2], 2), "%")) +
  scale_fill_manual(name  = "NEC",
                    values = c("No" = col_no, "Yes" = col_yes)) +
  scale_color_manual(name = "NEC",
                     values = c("No" = col_no, "Yes" = col_yes)) +
  guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 4, shape = 16))) +

    plot.subtitle    = element_text(vjust = 1),
    plot.caption     = element_text(vjust = 1),
    axis.title.x     = element_text(size = 18),
    axis.title.y     = element_text(size = 18),
    axis.line.x      = element_line(),
    axis.line.y      = element_line(),
    legend.position  = "bottom",
    legend.title     = element_text(size = 18),

    legend.key       = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = NA),

  )

# ── Add marginal histograms ───────────────────────────────────────────────────

pcoa_marginal <- ggExtra::ggMarginal(
  pcoa_plot,
  type        = "histogram",
  groupColour = FALSE,
  groupFill   = TRUE,
  xparams     = list(bins = 60, alpha = 0.8, position = "identity", color = "white"),

)

print(pcoa_marginal)

ggsave("4B_nec_PCoA_plot.pdf", plot = pcoa_marginal, width = 6, height = 5)

# LEGEND NUMBERS: Fig. 3b
pc3b <- phenos_imputed_div_pc_CLR %>% as.data.frame() %>%
  filter(!is.na(nec), !is.na(Clean_reads_P1), !is.na(DNA_conc), !is.na(Postnatal_Age))
set.seed(42)
ad_3b <- adonis2(as.dist(as.matrix(my_distance_CLR)[rownames(pc3b), rownames(pc3b)]) ~
                   Clean_reads_P1 + DNA_conc + Postnatal_Age + nec,
                 data = pc3b, permutations = 10000, by = "margin")
legend_out("Fig 3b - samples / infants by NEC status", pc3b %>% n_si(nec))
legend_out("Fig 3b - PERMANOVA, NEC (+ reads + DNA conc + postnatal age)",
           sprintf("n = %d samples / %d infants | R2 = %.4f | F = %.2f | p = %.2g",
                   nrow(pc3b), dplyr::n_distinct(pc3b$MM_ID), ad_3b["nec", "R2"],
                   ad_3b["nec", "F"], ad_3b["nec", "Pr(>F)"]))
legend_out("Fig 3b - PCoA variance explained (%)",
           sprintf("PCo1 %.2f | PCo2 %.2f", my_var_CLR[1], my_var_CLR[2]))
```

```{r}
#Figure 3C
taxa_sp_mixed <- read.delim("taxa_sp_mixed_all_nopbtx_prenec.txt")

nec_results <- taxa_sp_mixed %>%
  filter(Pheno %in% c("nec")) %>%  
  filter(FDR < 0.05)  

nec_results <- nec_results %>%
  select(Bug, Pheno, t.value, P, FDR) %>%
  rename(phenotype = Pheno) %>%
  group_by(Bug) %>%  # Group by Bug to check for duplicates
  slice_min(order_by = FDR, with_ties = FALSE) %>%  # Keep only the row with the lowest FDR
  ungroup()  # Ungroup after filtering

long_data <- melt(nec_results, id.vars = c("Bug", "phenotype"), measure.vars = "t.value")

# Order Bugs by t.value (highest positive to lowest negative)
long_data <- long_data %>%
  mutate(Bug = reorder(Bug, -value))  # Negative sign ensures descending order

long_data <- long_data %>%
  mutate(
    abundance_direction = factor(
      ifelse(value > 0, "More", "Less"),
      levels = c("Less", "More")
    )
  )

# Species names: underscores out, genus abbreviated, printed in italics.
# Set ABBREVIATE_GENUS to FALSE to keep the full genus name.
ABBREVIATE_GENUS <- TRUE

pretty_species <- function(x) {
  x <- gsub("_", " ", x)
  x <- sub(" sp ", " sp. ", x)
  if (ABBREVIATE_GENUS)
    x <- ifelse(grepl("^[A-Z][a-z]+ sp\\.", x), x,
                sub("^([A-Z])[a-z]+ ", "\\1. ", x))
  x
}

long_data <- long_data %>%
  mutate(Bug_clean = pretty_species(as.character(Bug)),
         Bug_clean = reorder(Bug_clean, -value))

# Flipped bar plot, species names in italics
tall_plot <- ggplot(long_data, aes(x = Bug_clean, y = value, fill = abundance_direction)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", color = "black", width = 0.7) +
  xlab("") +
  ylab("t-value") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 16, face = "italic"),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 16),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 16),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 16),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "#EBEBEB"),
    panel.grid.minor.x = element_line(color = "#EBEBEB"),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank()
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = alpha(c("Less" = "#1f77b4", "More" = "#CC79A7"), 0.9),
    labels = c("Less" = "", "More" = "")
  ) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(title = "Increased pre-NEC abundance")) +
  coord_flip()

ggsave(filename = "3C_nec.pdf", plot = tall_plot, width = 7, height = 6, dpi = 300)

# LEGEND NUMBERS: Fig. 3c
legend_out("Fig 3c - model file",
           sprintf("phenotypes: %d | species: %d | unique species x phenotype tests: %d | NEC tests: %d",
                   dplyr::n_distinct(taxa_sp_mixed$Pheno), dplyr::n_distinct(taxa_sp_mixed$Bug),
                   nrow(dplyr::distinct(taxa_sp_mixed, Bug, Pheno)),
                   sum(taxa_sp_mixed$Pheno == "nec")))
legend_out("Fig 3c - plotted species (FDR < 0.05)",
           nec_results %>% transmute(Bug, t.value = round(t.value, 2),
                                     P = signif(P, 3), FDR = signif(FDR, 3)))

tall_plot
```

```{r}
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Figure 3d — NEC prediction: two taxa (± birthweight), leave-one-out
# Input: phenos_imputed_div.txt (one row per infant sample; see README)
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# NEC Prediction — Two Taxa (± birthweight) at species & subspecies levels
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

library(pROC)
library(tidyverse)
library(writexl)

filter <- dplyr::filter; select <- dplyr::select
mutate <- dplyr::mutate; arrange <- dplyr::arrange
group_by <- dplyr::group_by; ungroup <- dplyr::ungroup
summarise <- dplyr::summarise; slice <- dplyr::slice; n <- dplyr::n


# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# STEP 1 — Load phenotype data and define the NEC outcome
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

phenos <- read.delim("phenos_imputed_div.txt", sep = "\t",
                     header = TRUE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
                     check.names = FALSE)

phenos$nec_timing <- phenos$necpostnatal - phenos$Postnatal_Age

phenos$nec_stage  <- case_when(
  phenos$nec_timing >= 0   ~ "pre_NEC",
  phenos$nec_timing <= 0   ~ "post_NEC",
  is.na(phenos$nec_timing) ~ "no_NEC"
)


# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# STEP 2 — Pick one sample per infant
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

pre_nec <- phenos %>%
  filter(nec_stage == "pre_NEC") %>%
  group_by(MM_ID) %>%
  slice_min(nec_timing, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup()

min_age <- min(pre_nec$Postnatal_Age, na.rm = TRUE)
max_age <- max(pre_nec$Postnatal_Age, na.rm = TRUE)

no_nec <- phenos %>%
  filter(nec_stage == "no_NEC") %>%
  group_by(MM_ID) %>%
  slice_min(Postnatal_Age, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(Postnatal_Age >= min_age, Postnatal_Age <= max_age)

final_dataset <- bind_rows(pre_nec, no_nec) %>% as.data.frame()
rownames(final_dataset) <- final_dataset$ID


# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# STEP 3 — Load taxa; build SPECIES and SUBSPECIES feature matrices
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

taxa <- read.delim("taxa_cleaned_jan.txt")
rownames(taxa) <- taxa$ID; taxa$ID <- NULL

build_level <- function(taxa, level = c("species", "subspecies"),
                        prev_min = 0.01) {
  level <- match.arg(level)
  sub   <- taxa[, grep("s__", colnames(taxa)), drop = FALSE]
  is_t  <- grepl("t__", colnames(sub))
  m <- if (level == "species") sub[, !is_t, drop = FALSE]
       else                    sub[,  is_t, drop = FALSE]
  colnames(m) <- gsub(".*s__", "", colnames(m))
  prev_ok <- apply(m, 2, function(x) sum(x != 0, na.rm = TRUE) /
                                     sum(!is.na(x))) > prev_min
  as.matrix(m[, prev_ok, drop = FALSE])
}

taxa_species    <- build_level(taxa, "species")
taxa_subspecies <- build_level(taxa, "subspecies")


# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# STEP 4 — Align; define outcome and birthweight (shared)
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

ids  <- intersect(rownames(final_dataset), rownames(taxa))
meta <- final_dataset[ids, ]

y <- ifelse(meta$nec_stage == "pre_NEC", 1, 0)
names(y) <- rownames(meta)

# Safe coercion (as.numeric() on a FACTOR returns level codes, not values).
num_safe <- function(x) if (is.numeric(x)) x else as.numeric(as.character(x))

stopifnot("bw" %in% colnames(meta))

# Birthweight, aligned to y. Scaled → OR per +1 SD. Scaling is a monotone
# transform → no effect on AUC; it only rescales the printed OR.
clin <- data.frame(
  bw        = as.numeric(scale(num_safe(meta$bw))),
  row.names = names(y)
)
stopifnot(!anyNA(clin))

# Log-transform aligned abundance matrix (pseudo-count avoids log(0)).
pseudo <- 1e-8
make_Xlog <- function(taxa_level, ids) log(taxa_level[ids, , drop = FALSE] + pseudo)

X_log_species    <- make_Xlog(taxa_species,    ids)
X_log_subspecies <- make_Xlog(taxa_subspecies, ids)

cat(sprintf("n = %d (events = %d)\n", length(y), sum(y)))
cat(sprintf("Candidate features — species: %d | subspecies: %d\n",
            ncol(X_log_species), ncol(X_log_subspecies)))


# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# STEP 5 — Shared helpers
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

# ── Univariate screen: one logistic regression per feature, ranked by AUC ───
screen_taxa <- function(X_log, y) {
  res <- tibble(Feature = colnames(X_log),
                AUC = NA_real_, Coef = NA_real_,
                OR  = NA_real_, p_value = NA_real_)
  for (i in seq_len(ncol(X_log))) {
    xi <- X_log[, i]
    if (length(unique(xi)) < 2) next
    fit <- tryCatch(suppressWarnings(glm(y ~ xi, family = binomial())),
                    error = function(e) NULL)
    if (is.null(fit)) next
    pred <- predict(fit, type = "response")
    res$AUC[i] <- as.numeric(pROC::auc(
      pROC::roc(y, pred, quiet = TRUE, direction = "<", levels = c(0, 1))))
    s <- summary(fit)$coefficients
    if ("xi" %in% rownames(s)) {
      res$Coef[i]    <- s["xi", "Estimate"]
      res$OR[i]      <- exp(s["xi", "Estimate"])
      res$p_value[i] <- s["xi", "Pr(>|z|)"]
    }
  }
  res %>% arrange(desc(AUC))
}

# ── Tidy coefficient table with Wald ORs and 95% CIs ────────────────────────
coef_table <- function(fit, name_map = NULL) {
  s <- summary(fit)$coefficients
  out <- tibble(
    Feature     = rownames(s),
    Coefficient = s[, "Estimate"],
    SE          = s[, "Std. Error"],
    p_value     = s[, "Pr(>|z|)"]
  ) %>%
    mutate(OR      = exp(Coefficient),
           OR_low  = exp(Coefficient - 1.96 * SE),
           OR_high = exp(Coefficient + 1.96 * SE))
  if (!is.null(name_map))
    out$Feature <- ifelse(out$Feature %in% names(name_map),
                          name_map[out$Feature], out$Feature)
  out
}

loo_taxa_clin <- function(X_log, y, clinical = NULL, n_taxa = 2) {
  N <- length(y); preds <- numeric(N); picks <- vector("list", N)
  for (i in seq_len(N)) {
    tr <- setdiff(seq_len(N), i)
    uni_i  <- screen_taxa(X_log[tr, , drop = FALSE], y[tr])
    uni_i  <- uni_i[!is.na(uni_i$AUC), ]
    pick_i <- head(uni_i$Feature, n_taxa); picks[[i]] <- pick_i

    tr_list <- list(y = y[tr]); te_list <- list()
    if (!is.null(clinical)) for (cn in colnames(clinical)) {
      tr_list[[cn]] <- clinical[tr, cn]; te_list[[cn]] <- clinical[i, cn]
    }
    for (k in seq_along(pick_i)) {
      nm <- paste0("sp", k)
      tr_list[[nm]] <- X_log[tr, pick_i[k]]; te_list[[nm]] <- X_log[i, pick_i[k]]
    }
    fit <- suppressWarnings(glm(y ~ ., data = as.data.frame(tr_list),
                                family = binomial()))
    preds[i] <- predict(fit, newdata = as.data.frame(te_list), type = "response")
  }
  list(preds = preds, picks = picks,
       roc = pROC::roc(y, preds, quiet = TRUE, direction = "<", levels = c(0, 1)))
}

auc_num <- function(o) as.numeric(pROC::auc(o$roc))
auc_ci  <- function(o) as.numeric(pROC::ci.auc(o$roc))   # c(low, auc, high)

# ── Full single-level analysis: 2-curve ROC + bw-adjusted odds graph ────────
run_level <- function(X_log, y, clin, level_label, file_tag,
                      fig_width = 4) {            # shared width for BOTH plots

  stopifnot(ncol(X_log) >= 2)

  # Two honest-LOO models for the ROC.
  loo_taxa <- loo_taxa_clin(X_log, y, clinical = NULL,                      n_taxa = 2)
  loo_bw   <- loo_taxa_clin(X_log, y, clinical = clin[, "bw", drop = FALSE], n_taxa = 2)

  # Descriptive birthweight-ADJUSTED model for the odds graph. Birthweight is a
  # covariate (so the taxa ORs are adjusted for it) but its row is hidden from
  # the forest plot below — only the two taxa ORs are shown.
  uni  <- screen_taxa(X_log, y)
  top2 <- head(uni$Feature[!is.na(uni$AUC)], 2)
  dat  <- data.frame(y = y, bw = clin$bw,
                     sp1 = X_log[, top2[1]], sp2 = X_log[, top2[2]])
  fit_adj <- glm(y ~ bw + sp1 + sp2, data = dat, family = binomial())
  coefs   <- coef_table(fit_adj, name_map = setNames(top2, c("sp1", "sp2")))

  pick_tab <- sort(table(sapply(loo_taxa$picks,
                   function(p) paste(sort(p), collapse = " + "))),
                   decreasing = TRUE)

  # Colours shared across both levels → same colour = same model.
  c_taxa <- "#264653"; c_bw <- "#e76f51"

  # ── FIGURE 1: ROC with two curves ──
  pdf(sprintf("ROC_NEC_%s.pdf", file_tag), width = fig_width, height = 6)
    plot(loo_taxa$roc, col = c_taxa, lwd = 2.5, legacy.axes = TRUE,
         main = sprintf("NEC prediction (%s) — taxa ± birthweight (LOO)", level_label))
    lines(loo_bw$roc, col = c_bw, lwd = 2.5)
    legend("bottomright", bty = "n", cex = 0.82, lwd = 2.5,
           col = c(c_taxa, c_bw),
           legend = c(sprintf("Taxa only (AUC = %.2f)",         auc_num(loo_taxa)),
                      sprintf("Taxa + birthweight (AUC = %.2f)", auc_num(loo_bw))))
  dev.off()

  # ── FIGURE 2: odds-ratio forest plot — two taxa, adjusted for birthweight ──
  # Birthweight stays in the model as a covariate; its row is dropped here so
  # only the two taxa odds ratios are shown. pretty_species() is defined in the
  # Figure 3c chunk.
  df_plot <- coefs %>%
    filter(!Feature %in% c("(Intercept)", "bw")) %>%
    mutate(label = pretty_species(Feature),
           label = factor(label, levels = label[order(OR)]))
  p_coef <- ggplot(df_plot,
                   aes(y = label, x = OR, xmin = OR_low, xmax = OR_high)) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey50") +
    geom_pointrange(size = 0.5, linewidth = 0.7, colour = "#fa2b13") +
    scale_x_log10() +
    theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
    theme(axis.text.y = element_text(face = "italic", size = 12)) +
    labs(x = "Odds ratio (per unit increase in log abundance)", y = NULL)
  ggsave(sprintf("3D_Coef_NEC_%s.pdf", file_tag), p_coef,
         width = fig_width, height = 3.5)      # same width as the ROC above

  # ── Console summary ──
  ci_t <- auc_ci(loo_taxa); ci_b <- auc_ci(loo_bw)
  cat(sprintf("\n══════ %s level ══════\n", toupper(level_label)))
  cat(sprintf("  candidate features : %d\n", ncol(X_log)))
  cat(sprintf("  top-2 (full data)  : %s | %s\n", top2[1], top2[2]))
  cat(sprintf("  AUC taxa only      : %.3f  (95%% CI %.3f-%.3f)\n", ci_t[2], ci_t[1], ci_t[3]))
  cat(sprintf("  AUC + birthweight  : %.3f  (95%% CI %.3f-%.3f)\n", ci_b[2], ci_b[1], ci_b[3]))
  cat("  coefficients ( ):\n"); print(as.data.frame(coefs))

  list(level = level_label, uni = uni, top2 = top2, coefs = coefs,
       pick_tab = pick_tab, fit_adj = fit_adj,
       loo_taxa = loo_taxa, loo_bw = loo_bw)
}


# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# STEP 6 — Run at both taxonomic levels
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

cat("\nRunning SPECIES-level models...\n")
res_species    <- run_level(X_log_species,    y, clin, "species",    "species")

cat("\nRunning SUBSPECIES-level models...\n")
res_subspecies <- run_level(X_log_subspecies, y, clin, "subspecies", "subspecies")


# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# STEP 7 — Export everything to one Excel workbook
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

# Long-format AUC summary: one row per level × model.
auc_row <- function(res, model_label, loo) {
  ci <- auc_ci(loo)
  data.frame(Level = res$level, Model = model_label,
             AUC = ci[2], CI_low = ci[1], CI_high = ci[3])
}
auc_summary <- bind_rows(
  auc_row(res_species,    "taxa only", res_species$loo_taxa),
  auc_row(res_species,    "taxa + bw", res_species$loo_bw),
  auc_row(res_subspecies, "taxa only", res_subspecies$loo_taxa),
  auc_row(res_subspecies, "taxa + bw", res_subspecies$loo_bw)
)


# LEGEND NUMBERS: Fig. 3d (same legend file as panels a-c)
legend_out("Infants analysed (one sample each)",
   sprintf("n = %d | NEC = %d | controls = %d", length(y), sum(y), sum(y == 0)))
legend_out("Check: nec = 1 without onset day (would be counted as control)",
   as.character(sum(phenos$nec == 1 & is.na(phenos$necpostnatal), na.rm = TRUE)))
legend_out("Postnatal age of the selected sample (days), by group",
   meta %>% mutate(group = ifelse(y == 1, "NEC", "control")) %>%
     group_by(group) %>%
     summarise(median = median(Postnatal_Age), min = min(Postnatal_Age),
               max = max(Postnatal_Age), .groups = "drop"))
legend_out("NEC cases: days from sample to onset",
   {x <- meta$nec_timing[y == 1]
    sprintf("median %g, range %g-%g", median(x), min(x), max(x))})
if ("probiotics" %in% colnames(meta))
  legend_out("Probiotic exposure at the selected sample, by group",
     as.data.frame(table(group = ifelse(y == 1, "NEC", "control"),
                         probiotics = meta$probiotics, useNA = "ifany")))
legend_out("Species-level candidate features (prevalence > 1%)",
   as.character(ncol(X_log_species)))
legend_out("Fig 3d - bw-adjusted model, species level (full data)", res_species$coefs)
legend_out("Fig 3d - top-2 pair selected across LOO folds (taxa only)",
   as.data.frame(res_species$pick_tab))
legend_out("LOO AUC (species)", auc_summary %>% filter(Level == "species"))

loo_preds_df <- function(res) data.frame(
  ID = names(y), y_true = y,
  pred_taxa_only = res$loo_taxa$preds,
  pred_taxa_bw   = res$loo_bw$preds
)

write_xlsx(
  list(
    "AUC summary"               = auc_summary,
    "Species - univariate"      = as.data.frame(res_species$uni),
    "Species - coefficients"    = as.data.frame(res_species$coefs),
    "Species - pair freq"       = as.data.frame(res_species$pick_tab),
    "Species - LOO preds"       = loo_preds_df(res_species),
    "Subspecies - univariate"   = as.data.frame(res_subspecies$uni),
    "Subspecies - coefficients" = as.data.frame(res_subspecies$coefs),
    "Subspecies - pair freq"    = as.data.frame(res_subspecies$pick_tab),
    "Subspecies - LOO preds"    = loo_preds_df(res_subspecies)
  ),
  path = "NEC_taxa_bw_species_subspecies.xlsx"
)

cat("\nDone. Figures: ROC_NEC_species.pdf, 3D_Coef_NEC_species.pdf,",
    "ROC_NEC_subspecies.pdf, 3D_Coef_NEC_subspecies.pdf\n")
```
